content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for NIT Silchar Project Associate (PA_I) Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 17-08-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NIT Silchar Project Associate position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Project Associate (PA_I) post at NIT Silchar is 17th August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Associate role?
faq.answer: Candidates need a B.E/B.Tech or M.Tech degree in a Science/Engineering/Technology stream with knowledge in mechanical instrumentation, CAD, and ANSYS. A B.Tech/M.Tech in Mechanical Engineering and English fluency are desirable.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Project Associate (PA_I) position is 30 years. Age relaxation is applicable for SC/ST/OBC/WOMEN/PWD candidates as per government rules.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Associate position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly salary ranging from Rs. 30,000 to Rs. 37,000, plus HRA.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the NIT Silchar Project Associate recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted via email. You need to prepare your bio-data, attach necessary documents, and send it to the official email address before the deadline.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Project Associate post?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Project Associate (PA_I) position will be based on an interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is NITS/Dean(R&C)/ME/713/2026.

faq.question: Q9. Which organization is conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: This recruitment is being conducted by the National Institute of Technology Silchar (NIT Silchar).

faq.question: Q10. What type of job is this?
faq.answer: The Project Associate (PA_I) position is a contractual job.
